definitions.gloss: to be damaged, to become worn
definitions.explanation: For something to become damaged, deteriorated, or worn through use or time.
For food to become rotten or unfit for consumption.

examples.japanese: この{建物|たてもの}は{長|なが}い{年月|ねんげつ}の{間|あいだ}に{少|すこ}しずつ{傷|いた}んできた。
examples.english: This building has gradually deteriorated over the years.

examples.japanese: {暑|あつ}いと{食|た}べ{物|もの}が{傷|いた}みやすい。
examples.english: Food spoils easily in the heat.

examples.japanese: {果物|くだもの}が{傷|いた}む{前|まえ}に{食|た}べよう。
examples.english: Let's eat the fruit before it goes bad.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pair: {傷|いた}める (transitive). Pattern: Xが{傷|いた}む.

HOMOPHONES:
・{痛|いた}む - to hurt, to ache
・{傷|いた}む - to be damaged, to spoil (this entry)

ASPECT: ている indicates a current state of being damaged/spoiled.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{髪|かみ}が{傷|いた}む (hair becomes damaged)
・{食|た}べ{物|もの}が{傷|いた}む (food spoils)
・{傷|いた}みやすい (easily damaged/perishable)
